entries.title: Sky Warlord Path
entries.summary: Sky Warlords specialize in combat focus, group movement, decisive strikes, and morale under fire.
body: This is a converted specialization for [[air-captain-class|Air Captain]]. Choose it when the parent class grants its path or domain at 3rd level.

sections.heading: Converted path progression
body: Path feature I — Combat Focus (3rd): Spend 1 command point to mark one visible enemy within 60 feet. Until the start of the captain's next turn, ordered allies gain +1 morale on attack and damage rolls against that target.
Path feature II — Tactical Retreat (7th): When issuing Advance or Brace, the target may instead move up to half speed without provoking attacks of opportunity. This costs 2 command points.

Path feature III — Battlefield Commander (11th): As an immediate action when an ordered ally hits, spend 1 point to add 2d8 precision damage or allow the ally an immediate bull rush, disarm, or trip attempt without provoking.

Path feature IV — Strategic Withdrawal (15th): Spend 3 points as a standard action. Up to five allies within 60 feet may immediately move up to half speed without provoking attacks of opportunity and gain +2 AC until their next turns.

Path feature V — Commander's Resolve (19th): Allies within command radius are immune to fear while the captain is conscious. Once per day, Inspiring Command grants twice the normal temporary hit points and lasts 1 hour.

sections.heading: Use with the base class
body: The five features are gained at parent-class levels 3, 7, 11, 15, and 19 respectively.
Unless a feature states otherwise, save DC equals 10 + one-half parent-class level + the parent class’s key ability modifier.
This path does not replace the parent class’s base attack, saves, skills, resource pool, bonus feats, or core class features.

sourceRefs.notes: Converted five-stage specialization for the twenty-level parent class.

entries.title: Explorer Captain Path
entries.summary: Explorer Captains specialize in route planning, reconnaissance, mapping, weather, and resource discovery.
body: This is a converted specialization for [[air-captain-class|Air Captain]]. Choose it when the parent class grants its path or domain at 3rd level.

sections.heading: Converted path progression
body: Path feature I — Skilled Navigator (3rd): Gain +4 competence on Knowledge (geography), Profession (air sailor), Survival, and vessel-control checks made for navigation. When a route permits meaningful optimization, travel time is reduced by 25 percent.

Path feature II — Uncharted Territory (7th): The captain and ordered allies gain +4 morale on saves against fear, altitude sickness, and exhaustion caused by travel. Once per day ignore the first failed route, weather, or navigation check and reroll it.

Path feature III — Quick Mapping and Adventurer's Lore (11th): After 10 minutes surveying an area, create a working map. Allies consulting it gain +2 competence on Search, Spot, Survival, and Knowledge (geography) checks in that area for 24 hours. The captain may recall major hazards and resources of any previously visited region without a check.

Path feature IV — Find the Path (15th): Once per day, after 10 minutes of concentration, identify the safest known route to a named reachable destination on the same plane. This reveals direction and major route hazards but does not expose secret wards or guarantee passage through changing terrain.

Path feature V — Treasure Seeker (19th): Once per day spend 10 minutes and attempt Search or Survival against DC 20. On success the GM identifies one real nearby useful resource, concealed route, safe camp, salvage cache, or overlooked supply within 1 mile, if one exists.

entries.title: Shipwright Captain Path
entries.summary: Shipwright Captains combine command with inspection, emergency repair, reinforcement, and permanent vessel improvement.
body: This is a converted specialization for [[air-captain-class|Air Captain]]. Choose it when the parent class grants its path or domain at 3rd level.

sections.heading: Converted path progression
body: Path feature I — Master Builder and Mechanical Insight (3rd): Gain +4 competence on Craft (shipbuilding) and Knowledge (architecture and engineering). As a standard action inspect a visible construct, object, or vessel zone; a DC 15 + target hardness check reveals a weakness and grants allies +2 insight on attacks or repair checks involving it for 3 rounds.

Path feature II — Reinforced Hull and Shipwright's Repair (7th): Spend 2 command points to grant one vessel zone +2 armor AC and temporary hit points equal to twice captain level for 5 rounds. As a standard action repair 1d8 + captain level damage to an adjacent vehicle component once per encounter.

Path feature III — Precision Construction and Quick Fix (11th): The captain may create simple locks, braces, traps, and shipboard devices as standard-complexity inventions. Once per day a 10-minute emergency repair restores 3d8 + captain level hit points to a vehicle or ship zone.

Path feature IV — Emergency Retrofit (15th): During 1 hour of work, install one temporary retrofit lasting 24 hours: +1 armor AC, +1 on one ship weapon's attacks, +10 percent speed, or +4 on one selected control or repair check. A vessel may carry one such retrofit per Shipwright Captain.

Path feature V — Legendary Build (19th): Permanent ship improvements personally led by the captain are treated as one invention-complexity category lower and receive one free quality improvement after successful testing.
